supports: Heji runs after the original card resolves and may follow the owner’s own use.
Heji follow-up ignores attack range and can recursively trigger itself; gained red cards can pay the next follow-up.
Conversions from Choufa, Weilin, Bianyu and Caoshao do not earn the red card.
Liubing includes colorless multi-material Slashes and excludes skill-cost discards.
additionalSources.authorityBoundary: Product-specific player strategy repost; not a dedicated official rules FAQ.

implementationInferences: Current native completed Use has exactly one effective/designated target; legitimate native target changes, armor, nullification, response uses and all extra-effect rounds retain their native rules. Mere played responses do not count as Use.

An entity Slash means a singleton printed Slash used with its printed kind and no identity/view-as conversion, as distinct from converted/virtual Slash. Its first-use Diamond appearance is frozen only for the real Use and target queries, never for an unplayed card’s discard/gain color. Actual-turn use history is recorded even while the actor lacks the skill.

Heji reward applies to a singleton genuinely nonconverted native Slash/Duel. A converted identity/view-as, multi-material virtual Slash or Fan conversion does not impersonate a printed original card. This follows the guide’s distinction; no separate dedicated Fan FAQ was located.

Random red acquisition uses the real seeded native DrawPile pool (printed red physical cards), not a virtual draw or manufactured card. When no red remains, the native reward obtains zero and the completed Use is still settled once.

Liubing considers the complete native Use’s actual damage, including added targets and repeated effects. It claims only the same physical use entities still in Discard with uninterrupted native Hand/HE→Processing→UseFinished provenance; previous claims, unrelated re-discards, response payments and costs do not qualify.

An already issued native follow-up/reward/claim continues draining its exact movement, HP, recovery, dying and skill-change children after source loss; a dead owner receives no newly offered follow-up or reward.

Heji also accepts independently payable zero-entity round-quota, DrawFundedDistinctBasic and chained-state Slash sources, together with variable-count Kenshang HE conversion and faction supply. Each source retains its existing native payment, name/quota, state-change, material and typed-return contract. Such transformed/logical uses do not earn the original-card reward or spend Liubing’s physical-Slash ordinal. An already-paid draw/state cost can finish its exact original need after Heji source loss; target/actor death cancels through the native paid-attempt contract without refund or duplicate cost.

An actual committed-use child may apply the existing CurrentSlashFirePolicy to the same issued Heji Slash. Its exact native policy and change event prove the final FireSlash and target history; the Heji invoice continues to prove the original accepted kind, material entities and conversion chain. Reward qualification additionally examines the completed current conversion chain, so a printed Slash genuinely converted to FireSlash after issuance earns no nonconverted reward. This is an implementation inference from the current skill text and the existing native conversion contract, not a separate official Wu Jing FAQ.
